qualification: All8 matrix cells and all models/policies/budgets retained; no refitting or new tuning.
Both grids are post-primary exploratory sensitivity, not replacement confirmatory tests.
Conditional query ranges average3 acquisition-order/tie seeds first; fixed split/source/scorer bank.
Splits/ranks/directions reuse cell observations and source summaries; overlap documents dependence, not independent biological replication.
Source-half displacement/support is finite split sensitivity, not calibrated confidence bounds.
Runtime is wall clock; memory peaks are process lifetime. Analysis CPU is separate; suite CPU is not inferred.
Historical development6428 and public-source/scorer resources remain separate from counterfactual purchases.
